name: Wand of Fear

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 7 charges: Command (flee or grovel, 1) or Fear (2), save DC 15.
text: The wand holds 7 charges, recovers 1d6 + 1 of them each dawn, and turns to ash and is destroyed if you roll a 1 on 1d20 after spending its final charge. While you hold it, you have two options. Command (1 charge): cast Command with a save DC of 15, giving only "flee" or "grovel" as the order. Cone of Fear (2 charges): cast Fear with a save DC of 15.
